deviation: The draft shortens the payment period from the standard 45 days to 30 days from receipt of a valid invoice. This is exactly the playbook fallback, so it is acceptable but gives Arcadia less cash-flow time. The rest of the clause (valid-invoice definition, good-faith dispute process, no suspension for disputed amounts) is neutral or favorable, and the draft has no late-interest term.
suggested_text: The Customer shall pay undisputed invoices within 30 days of receipt of a valid invoice.
